floats.description: A list of {{nbt|float|floats}} for the {{cd|range_dispatch}} model type. Missing values return the {{cd|fallback}} model.

flags.description: A list of {{nbt|boolean|booleans}} for the {{cd|condition}} model type. Missing value returns the {{cd|is_false}} model.

strings.description: A list of {{nbt|string|strings}} for the {{cd|select}} model type. Missing value returns the {{cd|fallback}} model.

colors.description: A list of RGB values or number providers for the {{cd|model}} type's {{cd|tints}}. Missing value returns the {{cd|default}} value provided by the item model definition. Can either be a list of lists, or an int array. When provided as a list, it will automatically convert to an int array.

custom_model_data.description: A list of values used by [ [items model definition] ]s for model selection and coloring.
